The '''Zoraster system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Zoraster sector/Legends|Zoraster sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="Region" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zoraster]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Condi]]. At some point by<ref name="JQ2" /> [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="Date">[[Jedi Quest 2|''Jedi Quest'' 2]] is set 28 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] [[Krayn]] [[Slavery/Legends|captured]] Condi, taking<ref name="JQ2" /> him<ref name="Path">''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]''</ref> off-world and forcing him to work aboard [[Krayn's pirate starship|his starship]].<ref name="JQ2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zoraster system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square U-13.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
